description: Look up normalized RDAP registration data for several domain names in one pooled call. Requires a Pro or Business plan; every domain in the batch counts against the quota.

domains.description: The domain names to look up, e.g. ["example.com", "example.net"]. Between 1 and 10 per call. Unicode (IDN) names are accepted. Pass registered domains, not hosts such as "www.example.com".

follow.description: Follow the registrar RDAP link for richer data on thin registries such as .com and .net. Slower; defaults to false.

whois.description: Set false to refuse the WHOIS fallback for every domain in the batch, so a TLD with no RDAP server returns not_supported. Defaults to true.

name: bulk-domain-lookup
title: Bulk Domain Lookup
